Vs.

full_judgment: 2. The Plaintiff-respondent filed the aforesaid suit for declaration of his title and the Defendants-petitioners filed Written Statement to the same. After framing of the issues, the case was fixed for peremptory hearing and at that stage, the Defendants filed an application for rejection of the Plaint on the ground that previously, between the parties, a suit being Title Suit No. 78 of 1977 was filed by the Respondent and the same was withdrawn and the cause of action of that suit and the present suit is the same; that the Defendant brought Title Appeal No. 93 of 1990 in the same Court for permanent injunction and got Decree on contest and against which the Respondent filed Title Appeal No. 100 of 1991 and, as such, the present suit is not maintainable.
